subject: Align schedules & owners for Nimbus Health POC kickoff — timeline, success criteria, and procurement
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@nimbushealth.com>, Liam O'Reilly <liam.oreilly@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Align schedules & owners for Nimbus Health POC kickoff — timeline, success criteria, and procurement

Hi Samira / Liam —

Great to hear Nimbus is ready to move forward. I want to lock in a POC kickoff that sets clear owners, timeline, and measurable success criteria so we can hit the 6-week evaluation window. High level ask: please confirm one of the time blocks below and who from engineering + procurement/security will join.

Proposed kickoff windows (PST):
- Tue 13 Oct, 10:00–11:00am
- Wed 14 Oct, 2:00–3:00pm
- Thu 15 Oct, 9:00–10:00am

Suggested attendees (we'll bring AE + SE + Solutions Engineer + onboarding materials):
- Nimbus: Samira Khan (Eng owner), Liam O'Reilly (Project lead), Priya Desai (Procurement)
- Redwood: Rafael Mendes (AE), Laura Bennett (SE, implementation), Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng)

Kickoff agenda (30–45 min):
1) Introductions & roles
2) POC scope & success criteria (latency targets, dataset slices, required integrations)
3) Timeline and milestones (data access, smoke test, acceptance)
4) Procurement / security checklist & next steps

Initial success criteria we propose:
- API throughput: sustained 50 requests/min at 250ms p95 for the inference path used in sample dataset
- Relevance: baseline prompt set with top-3 intent match >= 88% on your labeled sample
- Integration: S3 payloads accepted with secure credentials and audit logging in place

I've attached the POC scope v1 for quick review. If procurement needs a separate pre-POC contract milestone, flag that and we'll coordinate with our contracts team.

Thanks — can you confirm who will attend from Nimbus and which time works?

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: POC-scope-v1.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@nimbushealth.com>

Subject: Re: Align schedules & owners for Nimbus Health POC kickoff — timeline, success criteria, and procurement

Thanks Rafael — really helpful summary. We can do Wed 14 Oct 2:00–3:00pm PST. I'll attend, Liam will join, and I'm checking with Priya (procurement) for availability — she asked for a separate note about terms before the kickoff but can be on the call if needed. Also, our security lead (Anika Rao) wants to be copied into the kickoff invite so we can confirm audit/logging requirements.

Quick question: the 50 req/min at 250ms p95 seems aggressive for our production-like dataset — is there scope to run a smaller smoke test first and then a load run later in the POC?

Samira
Samira Khan
Principal Software Engineer, Nimbus Health
samira.khan@nimbushealth.com

Thanks Samira — Wed 14 Oct 2pm PST works for us. Looping in Laura (SE) and Karthik (Solutions Eng) so they can prep the implementation plan and pre-kickoff checklist.

Samira — good point on smoke vs load. Proposed approach:
- Kickoff (14 Oct): confirm scope, handoff dataset/credentials, and run a short smoke test during the session to validate connectivity and basic responses
- Week 1–2: integration + frame tests (small sample)
- Week 3: load-run window (schedule ahead with your infra)

Can you confirm Priya's availability for the kickoff? If she can't make it, please share procurement contact info and we'll follow with the required procurement packet.

I created a tentative calendar option and an invite stub here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-nimbus-kickoff-14oct (placeholder)

I'll attach our internal POC checklist for Laura to fill and return before kickoff.

— Rafael

Subject: Re: Align schedules & owners for Nimbus Health POC kickoff — timeline, success criteria, and procurement

Confirming SE coverage for Wed 14 Oct 2:00–3:00pm PST. Agenda I'll run (30–40m):
- 5m Quick intros & roles
- 10m POC scope & data handshake (we'll request a small sample S3 payload during the call)
- 10m Smoke test: basic inference on sample prompts + connectivity (expect 1–2 minute run)
- 10m Next steps: timeline for integration, load run scheduling, and procurement checklist items

Success criteria clarification (we'll make these measurable for the evaluation set):
- Connectivity: successful authenticated S3 uploads and event log entries visible in our audit stream
- Latency: p95 target for the smoke subset — target 250–400ms depending on payload size; we'll run both the smoke and a later load profile
- Quality: top-3 intent match >= 88% on your labeled sample (we'll need ~200 labeled examples for reliable signal)

Priya / Nimbus procurement — if you can confirm whether a short MSA + data processing addendum is needed before we begin, that helps us plan the timeline. If legal wants to review, we can provide standard templates in advance.

Forwarding this to our security contact for a quick pre-kickoff checklist:
